sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Cost recovery speed reduced by 5 for 40 seconds. [Demerit]
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes damage reflect, damage reduction, and continuous heal effects.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
Only [Giant Hammer Wielders] Mai & Yui can be used as Unlocking Potential material
